sections.history: Low mood for 6 days, starting a few weeks after delivery: tearful, anhedonia, guilt. Poor sleep even when the baby sleeps; persistent worry. Intrusive, unwanted thoughts of accidentally dropping the baby, which distress her; no urge or intent to harm the baby; avoids carrying him on the stairs. Passive thoughts that her family would be better off without her; no plans or intent; protective factor: baby. Previous depression at 19, treated with fluoxetine for a year. Her mother was admitted to hospital with a severe mental illness after a birth (possible postpartum psychosis). Breastfeeding. Has had panic attacks recently.
sections.medications_allergies: No regular medications. No known drug allergies.
sections.impression: Moderately severe postnatal depression with intrusive harm-related thoughts (ego-dystonic) and passive suicidal ideation without plan. Family history of possible postpartum psychosis.
sections.plan: Start sertraline 50 mg once daily (compatible with breastfeeding). No specialist referral needed. Inform health visitor. Talking Therapies details given (priority for new parents). Review in 1 week.
sections.safety_netting: If suicidal thoughts worsen or unable to keep herself safe, call NHS 111 (mental health option) or 999. Seek urgent help if confusion or hallucinations.
